preview.what: Authentication and authorization: Sanctum/Passport, guards, policies, gates.
preview.picture: Authentication is showing your ID at the door; authorization is which rooms your keycard opens. Policies are the rules per room.
preview.why: Token strategy for SPA vs mobile is asked in nearly every Laravel API interview.
preview.bn: Authentication = দরজায় ID দেখানো, authorization = কোন ঘর কার্ডে খোলে, policy = ঘরের নিয়ম।
